episode_title: FAA Ground Stop Update, Democratic Leadership Contest, Trump's Travels To Asia
script_en: FAA Ground Stop Update, Democratic Leadership Contest, Trump's Travels To Asia.

Airlines are recovering from a nationwide ground stop caused by a failure during routine FAA maintenance, raising new questions about the aging air traffic control system just ahead of the Thanksgiving travel rush.
Maryland Senator Chris Van Hollen is challenging Chuck Schumer to lead Senate Democrats, arguing the party’s midterm wins should not mean a return to business as usual.

President Trump heads to Asia for meetings with Vladimir Putin and Xi Jinping, where the White House says he plans to focus on nuclear weapons while leaving Ukraine and tensions over artificial intelligence off the agenda.
